import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Duration:
    years: int = 0
    months: int = 0
    weeks: int = 0
    days: int = 0
    hours: int = 0
    minutes: int = 0
    seconds: float = 0


_DURATION_RE = re.compile(
    r"P"
    r"(?:(?P<years>[0-9]+)Y)?"
    r"(?:(?P<months>[0-9]+)M)?"
    r"(?:(?P<weeks>[0-9]+)W)?"
    r"(?:(?P<days>[0-9]+)D)?"
    r"(?:(?P<t>T)"
    r"(?:(?P<hours>[0-9]+)H)?"
    r"(?:(?P<minutes>[0-9]+)M)?"
    r"(?:(?P<seconds>[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)S)?"
    r")?"
)

_DATE_FIELDS = ("years", "months", "weeks", "days")
_TIME_FIELDS = ("hours", "minutes", "seconds")
_DAYS_IN_MONTH = (31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31)


def _days_in_month(year: int, month: int) -> int:
    """Number of days in ``month`` of ``year``, allowing any year value."""
    if month == 2 and year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 != 0 or year % 400 == 0):
        return 29
    return _DAYS_IN_MONTH[month - 1]


def _format_seconds(seconds: float) -> str:
    """Format seconds in positional notation without a trailing fraction."""
    value = Decimal(str(seconds))
    if value == 0:
        return "0"
    text = f"{value:f}"
    if "." in text:
        text = text.rstrip("0").rstrip(".")
    return text


def parse(text: str) -> Duration:
    """Parse an ISO 8601 duration."""
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        raise ValueError(f"invalid duration: {text!r}")

    match = _DURATION_RE.fullmatch(text)
    if match is None:
        raise ValueError(f"invalid duration: {text!r}")

    parts = match.groupdict()
    if not any(parts[name] is not None for name in _DATE_FIELDS + _TIME_FIELDS):
        raise ValueError(f"invalid duration: {text!r}")
    if parts["t"] is not None and not any(
        parts[name] is not None for name in _TIME_FIELDS
    ):
        raise ValueError(f"invalid duration: {text!r}")

    return Duration(
        years=int(parts["years"] or 0),
        months=int(parts["months"] or 0),
        weeks=int(parts["weeks"] or 0),
        days=int(parts["days"] or 0),
        hours=int(parts["hours"] or 0),
        minutes=int(parts["minutes"] or 0),
        seconds=float(parts["seconds"] or 0),
    )


def format(duration: Duration) -> str:
    """Write ``duration`` in canonical ISO 8601 form."""
    date_parts = []
    for name, suffix in (("years", "Y"), ("months", "M"), ("weeks", "W"), ("days", "D")):
        value = getattr(duration, name)
        if value:
            date_parts.append(f"{value}{suffix}")

    time_parts = []
    for name, suffix in (("hours", "H"), ("minutes", "M")):
        value = getattr(duration, name)
        if value:
            time_parts.append(f"{value}{suffix}")

    seconds = _format_seconds(duration.seconds)
    if seconds != "0":
        time_parts.append(f"{seconds}S")

    if not date_parts and not time_parts:
        return "PT0S"

    result = "P" + "".join(date_parts)
    if time_parts:
        result += "T" + "".join(time_parts)
    return result


def add(moment: datetime, duration: Duration) -> datetime:
    """``moment`` plus ``duration``."""
    total_months = moment.month - 1 + duration.months
    year = moment.year + duration.years + total_months // 12
    month = total_months % 12 + 1
    day = min(moment.day, _days_in_month(year, month))
    result = moment.replace(year=year, month=month, day=day)
    return result + timedelta(
        weeks=duration.weeks,
        days=duration.days,
        hours=duration.hours,
        minutes=duration.minutes,
        seconds=duration.seconds,
    )
